name: io.github.HMAKT99/erabi
description: Reliability-checked discovery for paid agent APIs (x402): discover returns live uptime/latency/price with signed attestations your agent verifies instead of re-probing. Plus the open intent exchange: register, transact, earn verifiable reputation. Zero-config.

environmentVariables.name: ERABI_REGISTRY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Registry endpoint override. Defaults to the live public network.

environmentVariables.name: ERABI_EXCHANGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Exchange endpoint override. Defaults to the live public network.

environmentVariables.name: ERABI_ATTRIBUTION_URL
environmentVariables.description: Attribution endpoint override. Defaults to the live public network.

environmentVariables.name: ERABI_REPUTATION_URL
environmentVariables.description: Reputation endpoint override. Defaults to the live public network.

environmentVariables.name: ERABI_KEY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for persisting agent keys across sessions. Defaults to ~/.erabi/keys.
